steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in as admin with password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type it exactly like that). Then find the project Bench Project, go to its work packages, and report the subjects of all work packages whose subject starts with 'Seed:' exactly as shown.

02-create: In project Bench Project, create a new work package of type Task with subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' and a description that includes the text {{runid}}. Then set its assignee to the user Bench Assignee (must actually pick from the autocomplete dropdown), status to In progress, and finish date to 2026-12-31. Then add a comment on it whose text includes {{runid}}. Report the work package's numeric ID as displayed (#number), and the final values of subject, assignee, status, finish date, description, and comment text.
